description: This file contains the implementation of SQL store methods related to category boards in the focalboard server, including fetching, updating, reordering, and setting visibility of category boards.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: A struct representing the SQL storage layer for focalboard, with methods to manage category boards.

methods.name: getUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves category boards for a user within a team, including their attributes.

methods.name: getCategoryBoardAttributes
methods.description: Fetches metadata for boards within a specific category.

methods.name: addUpdateCategoryBoard
methods.description: Adds or updates category board associations for a user, handling deduplication and conflict resolution.

methods.name: categoryBoardsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of category board metadata objects.

methods.name: reorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Reorders category boards based on a new specified order.

methods.name: setBoardVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility (hidden or visible) of a board within a category for a user.
